args.body: Take SPONSORED-DATA-CHALLENGE as a bounded attempt to produce compensated-work inventory tied to an actual sponsor request, rather than another generic product or platform comparison. Check submission prerequisites before implementation. Reject known inaccessible dependencies promptly; do not prepare speculative entries. Missing service collection is not automatically relevant to sponsor-managed prizes. No advertised prize is verified funding, and an unsubmitted entry establishes neither acceptance nor revenue. Leave the three live experiments unchanged.

description: No new classified feedback is available; three unclassified sources remain unknown, and the latest private cycle processed zero messages. Verified funds and revenue remain zero. Missing collection blocks paid acceptance through the current service path, but does not establish that every sponsored-work route is inaccessible. Test one independent route with explicit compensation and executable acceptance criteria; preserve existing live experiments unchanged.
